integrity: Complete proof and executable finite verifier supplied; finite checks are not substituted for an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Requires at least three distinct cyclic run symbols, positive run lengths, and at least two exact copies of the period.
The result counts distinct nonempty contiguous closed factors, not all substrings with multiplicity.
No claim that all equivalent formulations outside inspected literature have been located.
title: Closed-factor spectrum of cyclic distinct-run powers
